roles.title: Backend Engineer
roles.description:
Backend Engineer
We're hiring a Backend Engineer to help build and scale the services powering our e-commerce platform. You'll work closely with product and frontend teams to design APIs, optimize database performance, and keep our systems reliable as we grow.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience building backend services in Node.js and TypeScript or a comparable stack.
- Strong understanding of RESTful API design; experience with GraphQL is a plus.
- Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and query optimization.
- Familiarity with message queues (Kafka) for asynchronous processing.
- Comfortable writing and maintaining unit and integration tests.
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes for container-based deployments.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and Linux environments.
- Nice to have: experience with Redis for caching, JWT-based authentication, and microservices architecture.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

roles.title: Cloud Engineer
roles.description:
Cloud Engineer
We're looking for a Cloud Engineer to design, provision, and operate the cloud infrastructure our products run on. You'll partner with product and platform teams to build environments that are secure, cost-efficient, and ready to scale.

What you'll need:
- Hands-on experience architecting and operating workloads on a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation) for provisioning and managing cloud resources.
- Solid understanding of cloud networking (VPC design, load balancing, DNS, and VPN/Direct Connect).
- Experience with containerized workloads on managed Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or AKS).
- Working knowledge of IAM and cloud security best practices (least-privilege access, encryption, security groups).
- Experience with cost optimization and cloud governance, including budgeting, tagging, and rightsizing resources.
- Familiarity with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) for automating infrastructure and deployments.
- Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, or Puppet) for fleet configuration and drift management.
- Working knowledge of observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, or Datadog) for monitoring, alerting, and incident response.

roles.title: Data Engineer
roles.description:
Data Engineer
We're looking for a Data Engineer to design and maintain the data pipelines that feed our analytics and machine learning teams. You'll work with large, messy datasets and turn them into reliable, well-modeled data products.

Requirements:
- Strong SQL skills and experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, and dbt.
- Proficiency in Python for data processing (Pandas, PySpark).
- Hands-on experience with distributed data processing (Apache Spark, Redis) and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).
- Understanding of data modeling concepts (star schema, slowly changing dimensions) and data warehousing best practices.
- Experience working with streaming data (Kafka).
- Comfortable with Docker and Kubernetes for containerized pipeline deployments.
- Experience with Power BI, AS400, SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, version control (Git) and CI/CD for data pipelines.
- Nice to have: experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code, Databricks, and data quality/testing frameworks (Great Expectations).
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

roles.title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description:
Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
We're building predictive and generative models that directly influence business decisions, and we need a Data Scientist / ML Engineer to take them from prototype to production.

Requirements:
- Strong background in Python, with experience using Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
- Comfortable working with SQL for data exploration and feature engineering.
- Experience fine-tuning and serving Large Language Models, including techniques such as LoRA/PEFT and prompt engineering.
- Familiarity with LLM application frameworks (LangChain or LlamaIndex) and vector databases (Pinecone, or pgvector) for retrieval-augmented generation.
- Experience deploying ML models to production, including MLOps practices (model versioning with MLflow, monitoring, CI/CD for ML).
- Solid grounding in deep learning and NLP fundamentals, especially transformer-based architectures (Hugging Face Transformers).
- Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field preferred, but strong practical experience will also be considered.

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.description:
DevOps Engineer
Join our infrastructure team to help build and operate the platform that keeps our services running reliably at scale. You'll work on automation, CI/CD, and observability across a multi-cloud environment.

What you'll need:
- Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform ).
- Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, and GitOps-based delivery (ArgoCD or Flux) in production environments.
- Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
- Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or Datadog).
- Solid understanding of Linux and Networking fundamentals.
- A plus: experience with Helm, service mesh technologies (Istio), and on-call incident response.

roles.title: Frontend Engineer
roles.description:
Frontend Engineer
Our product team is looking for a Frontend Engineer to build responsive, accessible web applications used by thousands of customers daily. You'll collaborate with designers and backend engineers to ship polished user experiences.

What we're looking for:
- Solid experience with React (hooks, component composition patterns) and TypeScript.
- Experience with server-side rendering and routing via Next.js (App Router).
- Understanding of state management patterns (Redux Toolkit or Zustand) and server-state tooling (TanStack Query).
- Proficiency with Tailwind CSS for utility-first styling.
- Comfortable working with REST or GraphQL APIs.
- Experience with build tooling such as Vite, and testing with Jest, React Testing Library, and Playwright.
- Fluent written and spoken English for daily collaboration with a distributed team.
- Experience with responsive design and cross-browser compatibility.
- A good eye for UI/UX detail and experience collaborating with design tools like Figma.
- Advantageous: experience with Next.js, Go, testing libraries (Jest, React Testing Library), and CI/CD pipelines.

roles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
roles.description:
Full-Stack Engineer
We are a fast-growing fintech startup looking for a Full-Stack Engineer who can move comfortably between frontend and backend work. You'll own features end-to-end, from database schema to the final UI polish.

Requirements:
- Proficiency in TypeScript across both React or Next.js (frontend) and Node.js (backend, Express or NestJS).
- Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
- Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and ORMs such as Prisma.
- Comfortable with Git-based workflows and code review.
- Experience with Docker for containerized development and deployment.
- Experience deploying applications to cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
- A pragmatic, product-minded approach to engineering trade-offs.
- Nice to have: experience with Stripe payment integrations and Kubernetes.

roles.title: IT Security Engineer
roles.description:
IT Security Engineer
We're looking for an IT Security Engineer to protect our infrastructure, applications, and data from evolving threats. You'll work across the stack to identify vulnerabilities, respond to incidents, and keep the company audit-ready.

What you'll need:
- Experience with vulnerability scanning and management (Nessus or Qualys).
- Hands-on experience with penetration testing tools (Burp Suite or Metasploit).
- Familiarity with SIEM platforms (Splunk) for monitoring and threat detection.
- Experience securing cloud environments (AWS Security Hub, IAM, or Azure Security Center).
- Solid understanding of Network Security and Firewalls.
- Scripting ability in Python or Bash for security automation.
- Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2 or ISO 27001).
- Experience with incident response and threat hunting.
- Advantageous: certifications such as CISSP or CEH.

roles.title: Java Developer
roles.description:
Java Developer
We're looking for a Java Developer to help design and build the backend services powering our platform. You'll work closely with product and platform teams to deliver reliable, well-tested APIs and services.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience building backend applications in Java (17+ preferred).
- Strong experience with the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security; Spring Cloud a plus).
- Solid understanding of RESTful API design and microservices architecture.
- Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL) via JPA/Hibernate.
- Familiarity with build tools (Maven or Gradle) and dependency management.
- Experience writing unit and integration tests with JUnit 5 and Mockito.
- Comfortable with Docker and container-based deployments to Kubernetes.
- Familiarity with message brokers (Kafka or RabbitMQ) for asynchronous processing.
- Nice to have: exposure to reactive programming (Spring WebFlux/Project Reactor) or Kotlin.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

roles.title: UI/UX Designer
roles.description:
UI/UX Designer
We're looking for a UI/UX Designer to shape how users experience our products, from early research through polished, production-ready interfaces. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to turn ambiguous problems into clear, usable designs.

What you'll need:
- 3+ years of experience designing digital products, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.
- Proficiency in Figma for wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design.
- Experience building and maintaining Design Systems and component libraries.
- Solid grounding in User Research and Usability Testing methods to validate design decisions.
- Understanding of Interaction Design and Information Architecture principles.
- Familiarity with Accessibility standards (WCAG) and designing for inclusive use.
- Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to collaborate effectively with engineering on implementation.
- Strong communication skills to present and defend design decisions to stakeholders.
- Advantageous: experience with Motion Design or tools like Adobe XD and Sketch.
